FN-W3PV55-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 194
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Matt Simpson
Commissions
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/27/2023
House Bill 194 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Onsite Wastewater
Board until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise
affect state or local funding.
